questions.title: Priority Queue Jump
questions.description:
A support desk lets a token jump the queue: the ticket with the given token is inserted at position pos (0-based, pos <= current length). The program scaffolding (includes and main) is already set up for you.

Implement only this function:

    std::vector<int> admit_at(std::vector<int> q, int pos, int token)

It must return the queue with the token inserted at pos. The harness prints the result space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated tickets. Line 3: pos and token.

Output Format:
One line with the updated queue.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 0 <= pos <= n, -1000000 <= tokens <= 1000000

questions.title: Discount Prices In Place
questions.description:
A store cuts the price of every item that costs MORE than the threshold: each such price is reduced by the fixed cut. Modify the vector IN PLACE (references, no copy out). Do not use std::transform. The program scaffolding (includes and main) is already set up for you.

Implement only this function:

    void discount_above(std::vector<int> &prices, int threshold, int cut)

The harness prints the updated prices space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated prices. Line 3: threshold and cut.

Output Format:
One line with the updated prices.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 0 <= prices <= 1000000, 0 <= cut <= 1000000

questions.title: Rotate the Roster
questions.description:
A duty roster is rotated LEFT by k slots: the element at index i moves to index (i - k) mod n. k can be 0 or larger than n. Do not use std::rotate — write the index math yourself. The program scaffolding (includes and main) is already set up for you.

Implement only this function:

    std::vector<int> rotate_k(const std::vector<int> &v, int k)

It must return the left-rotated copy. The harness prints it space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers. Line 3: k.

Output Format:
One line with the rotated elements.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 0 <= k <= 1000000000

questions.title: Deduplicate the Sorted Ledger
questions.description:
A ledger is sorted ascending; each value must appear once. Compact the vector IN PLACE with the two-pointer technique and return the number of unique values. Do not use std::unique. The program scaffolding (includes and main) is already set up for you.

Implement only this function:

    int dedupe_sorted(std::vector<int> &v)

The harness prints the returned length on one line and the compacted values on the next line.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (sorted ascending).

Output Format:
Line 1: the unique count. Line 2: the compacted unique values space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000000 <= values <= 1000000

questions.title: Count Readings in Range

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated readings. Line 3: lo and hi.

Output Format:
One line with how many readings satisfy lo <= value <= hi.

1 <= n <= 10000, -1000000 <= lo <= hi <= 1000000

Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated ids. Line 3: k.

questions.title: Vector Growth Model
questions.description:
A std::vector starts with capacity 1 and DOUBLES its capacity whenever an element is pushed into a full vector. Model k push_backs: count the reallocations and report the final capacity. Compute it with a while loop that doubles the capacity — no pow, no log. The program scaffolding (includes and main) is already set up for you.

Implement only this function:

    void growth_model(long long k, long long &reallocs, long long &capacity)

For k pushes: reallocs = floor(log2(k)) + 1 and capacity = the smallest power of two strictly greater than k.

Input Format:
One line with k.

Output Format:
One line with reallocs, then capacity, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= k <= 1000000000

Implement only this function:

    std::vector<int> purge_duplicates(const std::vector<int> &v)

The harness prints the result space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated IDs.

Output Format:
One line with the first occurrences in order.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 2000, -1000000 <= values <= 1000000

Rotate a vector LEFT by k WITHOUT extra storage, using the classic three-reversal trick: reverse the first k elements, reverse the rest, then reverse the whole vector. Write a reverse_range helper yourself (std::reverse is off-limits). The program scaffolding (includes and main) is already set up for you.

Implement only this function:

    void rotate_inplace(std::vector<int> &v, int k)

The harness prints the rotated vector space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers. Line 3: k (0 <= k).

Output Format:
One line with the rotated elements.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 0 <= k <= 1000000000

questions.title: Sliding Window Peak Load
questions.description:
A load monitor samples n CPU readings. For a window width w, every consecutive block of w samples is summed; report the maximum window sum. Use the sliding technique: sum the first window, then slide by adding the entering and dropping the leaving element. Sorting is banned. The program scaffolding (includes and main) is already set up for you.

Implement only this function:

    long long max_window_sum(const std::vector<int> &v, int w)

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated readings. Line 3: w (1 <= w <= n).

Output Format:
One line with the maximum sum over all windows of width w.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 5000, 1 <= w <= n, 0 <= readings <= 100000
